entries.observed_need: Durable mission state, explicit human gates, fail-closed integrity and resumable evidence are needed around a real runtime validation.
entries.recommended_action: Keep at the ABVX boundary; consider shared extraction only after a second real project demonstrates the same need.

entries.observed_need: Event freshness, source health and editorial coverage need conservative report-only observability with explicit UNKNOWN state.
entries.recommended_action: Record the pattern; do not extract into ABVX until a second real project demonstrates the same need.

entries.observed_need: Configured sources need separate observation health from event absence; no evidence must remain UNKNOWN.
entries.recommended_action: Retain as a project lesson and wait for a second project need before extraction.

entries.observed_need: Operators need a deterministic human report plus machine-readable evidence without autonomous editorial decisions.
entries.recommended_action: Keep report-only and project-local; Rule of Two is not met.

entries.observed_need: Events and practical guides inside one project both require conservative freshness observability, but their evidence models differ.
entries.recommended_action: Keep project-local for now; reconsider shared extraction only after a second real project demonstrates the pattern.

entries.observed_need: Event sources and guide content need separate provenance-health reporting; absence of evidence must remain explicit.
entries.recommended_action: Record the repeated within-project pattern; do not extract shared ABVX code under the current Rule of Two.

entries.observed_need: Guide claims need bounded read-only verification records that can influence freshness without rewriting public content.
entries.recommended_action: Keep project-local; do not extract a shared framework before a second project demonstrates the same claim-verification boundary.

entries.observed_need: Detected differences must become explicit editorial review proposals, never silent public-content mutations.
entries.recommended_action: Retain the VERIFY -> PROPOSE -> HUMAN/EDITORIAL APPROVAL -> UPDATE boundary; no shared extraction yet.

entries.observed_need: Volatility classes suggest different future verification cadence, but observations are not yet sufficient to schedule automatically.
entries.recommended_action: Record cadence guidance; do not build a scheduler or daemon.

entries.observed_need: Arbitrary owner material needs one local preservation and advisory-routing boundary before downstream taxonomy or project priority is chosen.
entries.recommended_action: Keep as the canonical ABVX intake boundary; add one explicit source integration only after human review of this MVP.
